channel.title: Aniket Vinchurkar
channel.description: Essays and investment theses on how Indian markets price things, and the things I build to find out.

item.title: IC Memo Auto-drafter
item.description: A multi-agent diligence tool. Type a company name, get a structured investment committee memo back in about two minutes.

item.title: People I’m Long On
item.description: Four people I have watched up close who are, in my reading, badly underpriced by everyone who hasn't met them.

item.title: UnDo
item.description: A Chrome extension that forces every task into an Eisenhower quadrant before you are allowed to write it down.

item.title: PPP Is Not a Fact About a Country
item.description: Every salary converter runs on a basket dominated by cereals, rent and fuel. Urban Gen Z does not spend against that basket. The real ratio is closer to 1.7:1 than 3:1.

item.title: Patient-Specific Implants
item.description: An investment thesis on custom 3D-printed prosthetics and implants in India. Why the constraint was never the printer.

item.title: India’s Foreigner-First Hospital Brand
item.description: An investment thesis: India is already a medical tourism hub, but there is no globally trusted, foreigner-first medical brand from India.
